name: Mossdeep City
lines:
When I was young, I traveled the world
as a Secret Base Expert.
Even now that I’ve become an old geezer,
my passion has not waned.
I’m waiting impatiently for a Secret Base
to appear just beyond that door.

There it is!
There it is! We’re connected!
On the other side of that door, we’re connected
to a Secret Base in parts unknown!
